Returns the changelog for the public database dumps, the REST API, and the MCP surface, newest release first. Each release corresponds to one published bulk dump; match `dump_sha256` against the `X-Pandects-Dump-Hash` response header (or the `dump_version.hash` body field) to see exactly which changes the data you are querying includes. `latest_version`/`latest_released` always describe the newest published release, even when `since`/`dump_sha256` filter the `releases` list.
